using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class FailoverSessionTests
    {
        // We test the logging of LogWarning on the awaited Task.WhenAll call in the method that calls BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync
        // We will simulate an exception thrown by one of the tasks to trigger the catch block with LogWarning.

        // Since the method is private and the class is internal sealed partial, we will test the behavior by invoking the public BeginAsyncReplicaFailoverAsync method
        // or by reflection if needed. But the snippet shows the call is inside a method that is not fully shown.
        // Instead, we will create a derived test class to override BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync to simulate the exception and test the logging.

        private class TestFailoverSession : FailoverSession
        {
            private readonly ILogger logger;

            public TestFailoverSession(ILogger logger)
            {
                this.logger = logger;
            }

            // Override BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync to simulate a task that throws
            protected override async Task BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync(string replicaId, byte[] configByteArray)
            {
                await Task.Yield();
                if (replicaId == "throw")
                {
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulated failure");
                }
            }

            // Expose the method that contains the attachReplicaTasks logic for testing
            public async Task TestAttachReplicaTasksAsync(List<string> replicaIds, byte[] configByteArray, FailoverOption option, string oldPrimaryId)
            {
                var attachReplicaTasks = new List<Task>();

                if (option == FailoverOption.DEFAULT)
                {
                    replicaIds.Add(oldPrimaryId);
                }

                foreach (var replicaId in replicaIds)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        attachReplicaTasks.Add(BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync(replicaId, configByteArray));
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        logger?.LogError(ex, "IssueAttachReplicas Error");
                    }
                }

                if (attachReplicaTasks.Count > 0)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        await Task.WhenAll(attachReplicaTasks).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        logger?.LogWarning(ex, "WaitingForAttachToComplete Error");
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task LogWarning_IsCalled_When_TaskWhenAllThrows()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var session = new TestFailoverSession(mockLogger.Object);

            var replicaIds = new List<string> { "replica1", "throw" };
            var configByteArray = new byte[0];
            var option = FailoverOption.DEFAULT;
            var oldPrimaryId = "oldPrimary";

            // Act
            await session.TestAttachReplicaTasksAsync(replicaIds, configByteArray, option, oldPrimaryId);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Warning,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("WaitingForAttachToComplete Error")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Dummy enum to match the code snippet
    internal enum FailoverOption
    {
        DEFAULT,
        FORCE,
        TAKEOVER
    }
}

                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
